faq.d1q: How can I place a mosque carpet order?
faq.d1a: You can place an order through Asil Halı's official website asilhali.com.tr or by phone. Our technical team will measure your mosque and prepare a custom price quote.
faq.d2q: How is mosque carpet measurement taken?
faq.d2a: The length and width of the mosque area are measured, with special areas like columns and the mihrab calculated separately. Our expert team can take exact measurements on-site or calculate from architectural plans.
faq.d3q: Which carpet type is most suitable for a mosque?
faq.d3a: It varies by mosque size, budget and usage intensity. Acrylic is preferred for small neighbourhood mosques while wool or polyamide is preferred for large mosques. You can benefit from our free consultation.
faq.d4q: How often should a mosque carpet be replaced?
faq.d4a: A quality mosque carpet can last 15-20 years. Regular cleaning and professional maintenance extend its lifespan.
faq.d5a: Delivery is provided within 3-6 weeks for standard orders and 2-3 weeks for urgent orders. You can track the production process transparently.
faq.d6a: Yes. Custom pattern design can be made to suit your mosque's architecture, colour scheme or regional tradition. The design process is free and production begins after your approval.

akrilik-cami-halisi.title: Acrylic Mosque Carpet
akrilik-cami-halisi.metaTitle: Acrylic Mosque Carpet | Prices, Varieties and Features – Asil Hali
akrilik-cami-halisi.metaDescription: Acrylic mosque carpet prices, varieties and features. Fade-resistant colours, soft texture, economical price. Custom-size production, delivery throughout Turkey. Asil Halı A.Ş.
akrilik-cami-halisi.description: With vibrant colours, soft texture and economical pricing, the most preferred mosque carpet type in Turkey.
akrilik-cami-halisi.longDescription:
Acrylic mosque carpet offers the best quality-to-price ratio among synthetic fibres and is used in the vast majority of mosques in Turkey. Thanks to high UV resistance, vibrant colours are preserved without fading for many years. It is produced with custom pattern designs that complement the overall atmosphere of the mosque.

The porous structure of acrylic fibres absorbs moisture that may occur in the mosque environment and evaporates it, ensuring a healthy floor surface. Acrylic carpets, manufactured to withstand daily congregation traffic, can be used trouble-free for 15–20 years with regular maintenance.

Asil Halı's acrylic range is offered with custom-cut options suitable for all mosque areas — from the prayer niche to the prayer rows, from staircases to corridor edges.
advantages: UV-resistant colours that do not fade for many years
Soft and comfortable texture — ideal for long prayer sessions
useCases: Shopping centre and workplace prayer rooms
Dormitory and student housing prayer rooms

faqs.question: How long does an acrylic mosque carpet last?
faqs.answer: A quality acrylic mosque carpet can be used trouble-free for 15–20 years with regular cleaning and maintenance. Asil Halı products come with a 5-year warranty.

faqs.question: Is acrylic or wool carpet better?
faqs.answer: It depends on your budget and usage intensity. Acrylic is more economical and easier to maintain; wool is more natural and longer-lasting. Both are suitable for mosques.

faqs.question: Can I have a custom pattern made?
faqs.answer: Yes. A custom pattern design matching your mosque's architecture or regional tradition is prepared free of charge; production begins after your approval.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: There is no minimum order quantity. You can order 10 m² for a small prayer room or 5,000 m² for a large mosque.

yun-cami-halisi.title: Wool Mosque Carpet
yun-cami-halisi.metaTitle: Wool Mosque Carpet | Natural, Durable, Premium Quality – Asil Hali
yun-cami-halisi.metaDescription: Wool mosque carpet: natural fibre, long life, thermal insulation and natural moisture management. Premium quality, custom-size production. Asil Halı A.Ş. – delivery throughout Turkey.
yun-cami-halisi.description: A luxury worship experience with natural wool's warmth, durability and natural resistance to moisture.
yun-cami-halisi.longDescription:
Wool mosque carpet holds a deep-rooted place in a tradition spanning thousands of years. Thanks to natural protein fibres, wool regulates temperature, manages moisture and contributes to the hygiene of the mosque environment. Wool carpets are far more durable than synthetic fibres and can last 25–30 years or more.

Wool's natural soil-repellent property preserves the carpet's appearance for a long time even under heavy use. Moreover, wool does not hold static electricity, preventing dust accumulation — directly contributing to the cleanliness of the worship environment.

Asil Halı's wool range is produced with the finest raw materials selected from New Zealand and Turkish wool, featuring traditional Islamic patterns. It is particularly recommended for the prestigious areas of large mosques, prayer niches and imam prayer areas.
advantages: Hypoallergenic — low risk of allergic reactions
Texture that develops patina over the years
useCases: Mosque complexes and historic mosque restorations
VIP meeting halls and religious ceremony areas

faqs.question: How is a wool mosque carpet cleaned?
faqs.answer: Wool carpets are cleaned with professional dry cleaning or cold water washing. Hot water and harsh detergents should be avoided. Professional maintenance 1–2 times per year is recommended.

faqs.question: Does wool carpet absorb moisture?
faqs.answer: Wool provides natural moisture management; it absorbs and releases humidity from the air, but it should not be placed on wet floors. Floor moisture insulation in the mosque is recommended.

faqs.question: Why is wool carpet more expensive than acrylic?
faqs.answer: Natural wool raw material is more expensive and the processing period is longer. However, when its 2–3 times longer lifespan is taken into account, it becomes more economical in the long run.

polipropilen-cami-halisi.title: Polypropylene Mosque Carpet
polipropilen-cami-halisi.metaTitle: Polypropylene Mosque Carpet | Durable, Easy-Clean – Asil Hali
polipropilen-cami-halisi.metaDescription: Polypropylene mosque carpet: stain-resistant, easy to clean, ideal for high-traffic areas. Modern technology, economical price. Asil Halı A.Ş.
polipropilen-cami-halisi.description: Modern polypropylene technology designed for high-traffic areas — easy to clean and stain-resistant.
polipropilen-cami-halisi.longDescription:
Polypropylene (PP) mosque carpet has the highest chemical resistance among synthetic fibres. Its moisture- and water-repellent structure minimises stain risk; liquids are easily wiped from the surface. This feature provides a major advantage in high-traffic mosques used by large congregations.

Polypropylene carpets are also resistant to UV rays; colour fading is minimal. Their lightweight structure makes installation and transportation easy. Being resistant to heat and sunlight, they are also suitable for open courtyards, terraces and outdoor use areas.

Asil Halı's polypropylene range demonstrates outstanding performance, particularly in busy metropolitan mosques and areas requiring constant use.
advantages: Superior resistance to water and moisture
Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
useCases: Winter mosque areas and heated floors

faqs.question: Is polypropylene carpet heat-resistant?
faqs.answer: It performs trouble-free at standard mosque temperatures (–20°C to +40°C). A special underlay is recommended for radiant heating systems.

faqs.question: How is polypropylene mosque carpet cleaned?
faqs.answer: It is easily cleaned with water and mild detergent. Suitable for steam machine washing. Can also be used with industrial cleaning machines.

polyamid-cami-halisi.title: Polyamide Mosque Carpet
polyamid-cami-halisi.metaTitle: Polyamide Mosque Carpet | Highest Abrasion Resistance – Asil Hali
polyamid-cami-halisi.metaDescription: Polyamide (nylon) mosque carpet: highest abrasion resistance, vibrant colours, professional solution for large mosque projects. Asil Halı A.Ş.
polyamid-cami-halisi.description: The finest among synthetic fibres. The choice of large mosques with high abrasion resistance and vibrant colours.
polyamid-cami-halisi.longDescription:
Polyamide (nylon) mosque carpet has the highest abrasion resistance among synthetic carpet fibres. In large mosques used by tens of thousands of people weekly, this feature is of decisive importance. Polyamide fibres maintain their shape and appearance for many years under intensive pressure.

Thanks to superior colour retention during the dyeing process, polyamide carpets preserve the most vibrant and deep colour tones for years. As the carpet type that best reflects the magnificent patterns of Islamic architecture, it is the professionals' choice in large mosque projects.

Asil Halı's polyamide range is produced with Solution Dyed Nylon (SDN) technology, guaranteeing colour fastness. It is widely used in large mosque tender projects and international projects.
advantages: Highest abrasion resistance — millions of footsteps
Fade-proof colours with Solution Dyed technology
useCases: Large metropolitan mosques (Friday and holiday prayer crowds)
Directorate of Religious Affairs and foundation major projects

faqs.question: What is the difference between polyamide and polypropylene?
faqs.answer: Polyamide has higher abrasion resistance and better colour retention capacity; however, it is more expensive. Polypropylene is more moisture-resistant and more economical.

faqs.question: What is Solution Dyed Nylon?
faqs.answer: It is a production method where the colour is embedded within the fibre. Unlike conventional dyeing, the colour is inside the fibre rather than on the surface. This provides superior colour fastness against UV, chemical and mechanical effects.

safli-akrilik-cami-halisi.description: Acrylic mosque carpet models with precisely aligned prayer row lines according to the mihrab direction, facilitating congregational prayer.
safli-akrilik-cami-halisi.longDescription:
Prayer-row acrylic mosque carpet features specially designed row lines aligned to the mihrab direction, facilitating the alignment of the congregation during prayer. Each row width is standardised at 60–65 cm and can be custom-adjusted to the mosque plan.

Thanks to acrylic fibre's UV resistance, the row lines do not fade or deform over the years. The row lines produced with special printing technology are woven into the carpet's texture and are resistant to mechanical effects.

Asil Halı's prayer-row acrylic range is custom-manufactured to the mosque's dimensions and can be personalised with any colour and pattern combination of your choice.
advantages: Precisely aligned prayer row lines according to mihrab direction
60–65 cm standard row width, custom-size option

faqs.question: Can the row lines be custom-sized?
faqs.answer: Yes, the row spacing can be adjusted according to your mosque's width. Custom widths beyond the standard 60–65 cm are also produced.

faqs.question: How is a prayer-row carpet maintained?
faqs.answer: Weekly vacuuming and professional washing 1–2 times per year are recommended. The row lines are resistant to staining and fading.

faqs.question: Is medallion carpet difficult to install?

ozel-desen-axminster-cami-halisi.metaDescription: Custom design Axminster mosque carpet. Unlimited colour and pattern options, Axminster weaving technology, premium solution for large prestigious mosques. Asil Halı A.Ş.
ozel-desen-axminster-cami-halisi.description: Fully customisable Axminster woven mosque carpet with unlimited colour and pattern options — a unique design for every mosque.
ozel-desen-axminster-cami-halisi.longDescription:
Axminster weaving technology enables the production of a unique carpet for every mosque with unlimited colour and pattern combinations. With this technology, your mosque's architecture, Islamic motifs and colour preferences are flawlessly transferred onto the carpet.

Axminster carpets are produced using a precision weaving method where each knot is individually processed. This produces multi-coloured complex Islamic patterns, geometric motifs and arabesque compositions with the highest detail quality.

Asil Halı's Axminster range is offered with free design consultancy and 3D visualisation service. You can see your custom design by sending your mosque's photographs and dimensions.
advantages: Unlimited colours — dozens of colours simultaneously
Unique pattern specific to your mosque
useCases: Any size mosque wanting custom patterns

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity for Axminster carpet?
faqs.answer: Generally a minimum of 50 m² is required for custom production. The standard collection is recommended for smaller areas.

faqs.question: How does the design process work?
faqs.answer: Your mosque's dimensions and design preferences are taken. A 3D visualisation is prepared, and production begins after your approval. An average production time of 6–10 weeks is required.

kaucuk-cami-halisi-altligi.title: Rubber Mosque Carpet Underlay
kaucuk-cami-halisi-altligi.metaTitle: Rubber Mosque Carpet Underlay | Non-Slip Base, Long Life – Asil Hali
kaucuk-cami-halisi-altligi.metaDescription: Rubber mosque carpet underlay. Non-slip base, sound insulation, moisture barrier. Extends carpet life. TredMOR and other rubber underlay models. Asil Halı A.Ş.
kaucuk-cami-halisi-altligi.description: Rubber underlay installed beneath mosque carpet — prevents slipping, insulates sound and extends carpet life.
kaucuk-cami-halisi-altligi.longDescription:
Rubber mosque carpet underlay is an important construction material that secures the carpet to the floor and serves multiple protective functions.

Thanks to its non-slip rubber base, the carpet stays in place and prayer row alignment is not disrupted during prayer. At the same time, it forms a moisture barrier between the floor and carpet, preventing mould formation.

With its sound insulation feature, footstep noise beneath the carpet is reduced, providing a peaceful environment during prayer. It also slows carpet wear, increasing total service life by 30–40%.
advantages: Non-slip rubber base — prevents carpet slipping

faqs.question: Does rubber underlay damage the carpet?
faqs.answer: No. Rubber underlays do not damage carpet fibres; on the contrary, they reduce wear.

tredmor-berber-supreme.title: TredMOR™ Berber Supreme
tredmor-berber-supreme.metaTitle: TredMOR™ Berber Supreme Mosque Carpet Underlay – Asil Hali
tredmor-berber-supreme.metaDescription: TredMOR Berber Supreme rubber mosque carpet underlay. Premium non-slip underlay, maximum moisture barrier, long life. Asil Halı A.Ş. Turkey distributor.
tredmor-berber-supreme.description: TredMOR™ brand's premium Berber Supreme rubber underlay — the highest level of protection and comfort for mosque carpets.
tredmor-berber-supreme.longDescription:
TredMOR™ Berber Supreme is the top product in the premium segment among mosque carpet underlays. Thanks to its special rubber compound and Berber-woven upper surface, it offers both underlay and under-carpet cushioning in a single product.

The unique texture of the Berber surface achieves a perfect fit with the mosque carpet on top. It completely prevents carpet slipping and maximises sound insulation.

Asil Halı is the authorised distributor of TredMOR™ products in Turkey.

faqs.question: Where is TredMOR Berber Supreme manufactured?
faqs.answer: TredMOR is manufactured with premium quality control standards. Asil Halı is the authorised distributor in Turkey.

kece-cami-halisi-altligi.title: Felt Mosque Carpet Underlay
kece-cami-halisi-altligi.metaTitle: Felt Mosque Carpet Underlay | 600 1000 1200 g/m² Felt – Asil Hali
kece-cami-halisi-altligi.metaDescription: Felt mosque carpet underlay models. 600 g, 1000 g and 1200 g/m² options. Sound and thermal insulation, extends carpet life. Asil Halı A.Ş.
kece-cami-halisi-altligi.description: Felt underlay solutions for mosque carpets with sound and thermal insulation in 600, 1000 and 1200 g/m² options.
kece-cami-halisi-altligi.longDescription:
Felt mosque carpet underlays are insulation layers produced from dense felt fibre, laid beneath the carpet. Different density options provide solutions suitable for every budget and requirement.

600 g/m² felt is suitable for budget-friendly projects. 1000 g/m² is a balanced choice for medium-to-large mosques. 1200 g/m² is ideal for large projects requiring the highest sound and thermal insulation.

Felt underlays protect the carpet from floor hardness and reduce congregation fatigue during long prayer sessions.

faqs.question: Which felt density is the right choice?
faqs.answer: 600 g/m² is recommended for budget projects, 1000 g/m² for standard mosque projects and 1200 g/m² for large and prestigious mosques.

600-cami-halisi-kecesi.title: 600 g/m² Mosque Carpet Felt
600-cami-halisi-kecesi.metaTitle: 600 g/m² Mosque Carpet Felt | Economical Carpet Underlay – Asil Hali
600-cami-halisi-kecesi.metaDescription: 600 g/m² mosque carpet felt. Economical price, basic sound and thermal insulation. Suitable carpet underlay for small and medium mosques. Asil Halı A.Ş.
600-cami-halisi-kecesi.description: Economical 600 g/m² felt mosque carpet underlay for small and medium-sized mosques.
600-cami-halisi-kecesi.longDescription: 600 g/m² mosque carpet felt is a cost-effective carpet underlay solution for budget-friendly projects and small-to-medium mosques. It provides basic sound and thermal insulation while offering a budget-friendly option.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 600 and 1000 felt?
faqs.answer: 1000 g/m² felt has higher density and provides better sound and thermal insulation. 600 g/m² is more economical but offers adequate basic insulation.

1000-cami-halisi-kecesi.title: 1000 g/m² Mosque Carpet Felt
1000-cami-halisi-kecesi.metaTitle: 1000 g/m² Mosque Carpet Felt | Standard Carpet Underlay – Asil Hali
1000-cami-halisi-kecesi.metaDescription: 1000 g/m² mosque carpet felt. Standard sound and thermal insulation, a balanced choice for medium-to-large mosque projects. Asil Halı A.Ş.
1000-cami-halisi-kecesi.description: 1000 g/m² felt underlay offering balanced sound and thermal insulation for medium-to-large mosque projects.
1000-cami-halisi-kecesi.longDescription: 1000 g/m² mosque carpet felt is a balanced and sufficient solution for most medium and large mosques. Its sound insulation and heat retention properties are significantly higher than the 600 g/m² felt.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order for 1000 felt?
faqs.answer: Yes, generally a minimum order of 50 m² is accepted. Please contact us for smaller quantities.

1200-cami-halisi-kecesi.title: 1200 g/m² Mosque Carpet Felt
1200-cami-halisi-kecesi.metaTitle: 1200 g/m² Mosque Carpet Felt | Premium Carpet Underlay – Asil Hali
1200-cami-halisi-kecesi.metaDescription: 1200 g/m² mosque carpet felt. The highest sound and thermal insulation, premium underlay for large prestigious mosques. Asil Halı A.Ş.
1200-cami-halisi-kecesi.description: 1200 g/m² premium felt offering the highest sound and thermal insulation — for large prestigious mosques.
1200-cami-halisi-kecesi.longDescription: 1200 g/m² mosque carpet felt is the highest-density felt underlay, preferred for large metropolitan mosques, prestigious projects and areas requiring the highest level of sound and thermal insulation. Maximum comfort is ensured for the congregation during long prayer sessions.

faqs.question: Can 1200 felt and rubber underlay be used together?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially in large projects, the combination of 1200 g/m² felt on top and rubber underlay beneath gives the best results.

stok-cami-halisi.description: Standard-size mosque carpets available in our warehouse for immediate delivery for urgent needs.
stok-cami-halisi.longDescription: Our stock mosque carpet range consists of standard quality and patterns that are continuously available in our factory for projects with urgent carpet needs. They can be dispatched immediately without any waiting period.
useCases: Places of worship with rapid opening schedules

faqs.question: Are stock carpets defective?
faqs.answer: No, our stock carpets are first-quality standard productions. They consist of overproduced batches.
